bio.title: Platform Security & Software Engineer
paragraphs: I'm Abishek VP, a senior software engineer specializing in building robust solutions with a security-first backend architecture, platform security, identity integrations, and workflow automation. I design and build PAM (Privileged Access Management) workflows, password automation, and platform components that handle authentication, directory management, approval flows, and secure communication.

At Securden, I build enterprise-grade PAM capabilities including Password Self-Service, identity provider integrations, directory sync, JIT access workflows, approval engines, password vault operations, and microservices supporting secure platform features. I also develop automation plugins for Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet for dynamic credential retrieval inside CI/CD ecosystems.

My experience spans backend development, identity engineering, platform integrations, DevOps automation, and full-stack solutions across multiple organizations. I enjoy solving challenging problems in secure communication, identity lifecycle management, automation workflows, and building distributed, highly reliable systems.
Outside work, I build tools, explore automation workflows, guide students and juniors, and mentor peers in software engineering.
